title: One-to-One Relations
description: Define and query one-to-one relations in Prisma, such as a User and a Profile.

data.text: A one-to-one relation means each record in Model A can relate to at most one record in Model B, and vice versa. In Prisma, this is defined by a relation field on both models without an array.

data.title: Tip
data.text: The `@unique` attribute on the foreign key (`userId`) enforces the one-to-one constraint at the database level.
